sources.title: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-NVFP4 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-NVFP4 is a general purpose reasoning and chat model intended to be used in English and coding languages. Other non-English languages (Spanish, French, German, Italian, Japanese) are also supported.

sources.title: Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter ...
sources.snippet: Mistral AI has just announced the release of Mistral Large 4 (ML4), internally nicknamed Le Chonk, as a public preview. ML4 is a granular Mixture of Experts model with 1.05 trillion total parameters, 49 billion active per token, a 1.6 billion parameter vision encoder, and a 1 million token context window, per the model documentation.
